Cybersecurity will be **the biggest AI investment category**; agents will scale work previously compute-limited.
**Coding and knowledge work are saturating** with sub-frontier models. Frontier compute is shifting to **new discovery and applications** (medicine, science).
**Agent drafts every customer support reply, call recap, and 'what went wrong' note.** Founder just reads and hits send; CRM + bug filing automated.
**Static credentials are obsolete.** Design for self-destructing keys and OIDC-based access; industry should build 'green locks' encryption for credentials like TLS did for HTTPS.

Anthropic has **$587B in compute commitments**; this is the scaling constraint, not demand. VCs claiming founder quality trumps co-founder count are wrong (Anthropic and Databricks both have 7 co-founders).

**Understanding LLM outputs is harder than prompting.** Karpathy highlights controlled languages and reasoning traces as the frontier for reliability.
Artificial Analysis moves to **closed benchmarks**, finds **open-weight models falling further behind** frontier. No Fable-class open model in recent releases.
Genie 4 generates game-like environments **in real-time**, accepts natural language steering, **adds NPCs and objects iteratively.**
